main_sections.title: Introduction
main_sections.disposition: Historical pathway/growth comparisons and kinetic data are traced to earlier originals; no fresh growth claim.

main_sections.title: Crystal structure analysis of DesB
main_sections.disposition: Recombinant DesB preparation and anaerobic crystallization; follows inspected 2009 methods.

main_sections.title: Crystal structure analysis of the anaerobic DesB-gallate and DesB-PCA complexes
main_sections.disposition: Anaerobic gallate/PCA soaks and H124F crystal distinguish ligand states.

main_sections.title: Crystal structure analysis of the DesB-gallate complex exposed to the aerobic conditions (the aerobic DesB-gallate complex)
main_sections.disposition: Thirty-minute aerobic exposure; do not inherit a later anaerobic wording slip as actual condition.

main_sections.title: Crystal structure analysis of the DesB-gallate complex by co-crystallization
main_sections.disposition: Separate co-crystallization confirms some alternate Fe density but not exact site occupancy.

main_sections.title: Biochemical analysis of the mutants and their CD spectra
main_sections.disposition: H124F/H192F PCR variants; CD comparison checked in supplement.

main_sections.title: Measurement of enzyme activity
main_sections.disposition: All assay preparation and reactivation conditions retained; auto-degradation/product-absorbance corrections and mutant detection limits.

main_sections.title: Structural comparison and molecular graphics
main_sections.disposition: Graphics/superposition methods; no new biological identity.

main_sections.title: Data deposition
main_sections.disposition: All nine PDB deposition identifiers retained as source-reported structural entries; not authority-promoted CURIEs.

main_sections.title: Crystal structures of DesB and its anaerobic substrate complex
main_sections.disposition: Dimer, iron, gallate binding and mutant activity all inspected; metal/protein state kept local.

main_sections.title: Fe-ion shift upon substrate binding
main_sections.disposition: All seven paragraphs inspected; iron-shift model, predetermined occupancies, crystal variability and ambiguity preserved.

main_sections.title: Crystal structures of the aerobic DesB-gallate complex
main_sections.disposition: Both crystal reaction interpretations retained; TableS2 contradiction flagged.

main_sections.title: Crystal structure of the DesB-PCA complex
main_sections.disposition: PCA binding is nonproductive, not a catalysis or inhibition claim.

main_sections.title: Crystal structure of the DesB (His124Phe)-gallate complex
main_sections.disposition: H124F binding structure is a construct-specific mechanistic comparison.

main_sections.title: Discussion
main_sections.disposition: All four discussion paragraphs inspected; residue/O2 roles are proposed; 3MGA orientation predicted; alternative metals discussed across enzymes.

main_sections.title: Supporting Information
main_sections.disposition: All ten linked supplements downloaded and their complete single pages visually inspected.

objects.label: Figure 1
objects.disposition: Both panels visually inspected. O2 and Fe(II) are distinguished; product is an unnamed enol drawing requiring reconciliation, not an authority-ready identity.

objects.label: Table 1
objects.disposition: All rows and columns visually inspected and parsed from XML: substrate-free WT, anaerobic gallate WT, aerobic gallate WT, H124F and PCA structures with differing conditions/resolution.

objects.label: Table 2
objects.disposition: All rows/columns inspected and parsed: P21 gallate structures with and without observable shift; disordered protomer A and gallate only in B noted.

objects.label: Figure 2
objects.disposition: All four panels inspected. Homodimer and intersubunit active sites; direct resting Fe and gallate model, comparison with LigAB; no equality of enzyme identity.

objects.label: Figure 3
objects.disposition: All four panels inspected. Alternative R/A sites, omit maps, aerobic comparison, nonproductive PCA complex. Occupancies and crystal-turnover uncertainty remain.

objects.label: Figure 4
objects.disposition: Both panels inspected. H124 movement, mutant binding and retained resting Fe; mutant material distinguished from wild type.

objects.label: Figure 5
objects.disposition: Entire schematic inspected; summarizes a proposed recognition/Fe-shift sequence, not direct observation of all dynamic transitions.

objects.label: Figure S1
objects.disposition: Figure S1: complete density/stereo image inspected, substrate-free Fe site; no extra enzyme activity assertion.

objects.label: Figure S2
objects.disposition: Figure S2: complete far-UV CD curves inspected; H192F resembles WT, does not prove atom-level folding or full iron occupancy.

objects.label: Figure S3
objects.disposition: Figure S3: both panels inspected; DesB/BphC active-site comparison, not a new gallate-pathway BphC node.

objects.label: Figure S4
objects.disposition: Figure S4: all four panels inspected; iron alternatives present in some crystals, weak A-site density without refined alternate model in another.

objects.label: Figure S5
objects.disposition: Figure S5: all steric views inspected; modeled geometric argument for movement, not measured time-resolved motion.

objects.label: Figure S6
objects.disposition: Publisher Figure S6 oxygen-site image inspected; PDF internally says Figure S7 and labels ligand PCA although publisher caption says gallate. Oxygen site remains predicted.

objects.label: Table S1
objects.disposition: Table S1: complete 3x3 kinetic comparison inspected; cites 2005 reference6, not fresh2014 data; ND not defined in this one-page supplement.

objects.label: Table S2
objects.disposition: Table S2: all 12 protomer columns, conditions, occupancies, B-factors and footnotes inspected. Preset0.5 not a measurement; aerobic3WRA substrate1.0 conflicts with main result and absent B-factor.

objects.label: Table S3
objects.disposition: Table S3: all10 coordination rows and two footnotes inspected. Productive complex values apply to A-site; do not remove author cautions on His ligands.

objects.label: Table S4
objects.disposition: Table S4: all four protomer columns inspected; no refined A-site, elevated Fe B-factors and disordered A columns; lack of a shift model not universal absence.
